# CSS Generation

The GsmUi CSS Generator produces optimized CSS output from theme tokens, with support for Tailwind integration, minification, and source maps.

## Generator Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Tailwind config | Generate Tailwind plugin |
| Custom CSS | Direct CSS output |
| Minification | Optimized file size |
| Source maps | Debug support |
| PostCSS | PostCSS plugin |

## Tailwind Config Generation

### Generated Config

```javascript
// tailwind.config.js (generated)
module.exports = {
    theme: {
        extend: {
            colors: {
                primary: {
                    DEFAULT: 'var(--gsmui-color-primary)',
                    hover: 'var(--gsmui-color-primary-hover)',
                    light: 'var(--gsmui-color-primary-light)',
                },
                surface: {
                    DEFAULT: 'var(--gsmui-color-surface)',
                    alt: 'var(--gsmui-color-surface-alt)',
                },
                content: {
                    DEFAULT: 'var(--gsmui-color-text)',
                    secondary: 'var(--gsmui-color-text-secondary)',
                },
                border: {
                    DEFAULT: 'var(--gsmui-color-border)',
                    light: 'var(--gsmui-color-border-light)',
                },
            },
            borderRadius: {
                sm: 'var(--gsmui-radius-sm)',
                md: 'var(--gsmui-radius-md)',
                lg: 'var(--gsmui-radius-lg)',
                xl: 'var(--gsmui-radius-xl)',
            },
            boxShadow: {
                sm: 'var(--gsmui-shadow-sm)',
                md: 'var(--gsmui-shadow-md)',
                lg: 'var(--gsmui-shadow-lg)',
            },
        },
    },
};
```

### Tailwind Plugin

```javascript
// GsmUi Tailwind Plugin (generated)
const plugin = require('tailwindcss/plugin');

module.exports = plugin(function({ addComponents, theme }) {
    addComponents({
        '.gsmui-button': {
            background: theme('colors.primary.DEFAULT'),
            color: 'white',
            borderRadius: theme('borderRadius.md'),
            padding: `${theme('spacing.2')} ${theme('spacing.4')}`,
            '&:hover': {
                background: theme('colors.primary.hover'),
            },
        },
    });
});
```

### Generation Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | `gsmui` | Variable prefix |
| `format` | `js` | Output format (`js`, `ts`) |
| `include_plugin` | `true` | Include Tailwind plugin |
| `responsive` | `true` | Include responsive tokens |

## Custom CSS Output

### Generated CSS

```css
/* Generated by GsmUi Theme Engine */
/* Version: 2.15.0 */

:root {
    /* Colors */
    --gsmui-color-primary: #2563eb;
    --gsmui-color-primary-hover: #1d4ed8;
    --gsmui-color-primary-light: #dbeafe;
    --gsmui-color-surface: #ffffff;
    --gsmui-color-surface-alt: #f9fafb;
    --gsmui-color-text: #18181b;
    --gsmui-color-text-secondary: #71717a;
    --gsmui-color-border: #e4e4e7;

    /* Spacing */
    --gsmui-space-1: 0.25rem;
    --gsmui-space-2: 0.5rem;
    --gsmui-space-3: 0.75rem;
    --gsmui-space-4: 1rem;

    /* Typography */
    --gsmui-font-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
    --gsmui-text-sm: 0.875rem;
    --gsmui-text-base: 1rem;

    /* Radius */
    --gsmui-radius-sm: 0.25rem;
    --gsmui-radius-md: 0.375rem;
    --gsmui-radius-lg: 0.5rem;

    /* Shadows */
    --gsmui-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    --gsmui-shadow-md: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

/* Component Classes */
.gsmui-button {
    background: var(--gsmui-button-bg, var(--gsmui-color-primary));
    color: var(--gsmui-button-text, white);
    border-radius: var(--gsmui-button-radius, var(--gsmui-radius-md));
}

.gsmui-input {
    background: var(--gsmui-input-bg, var(--gsmui-color-surface));
    border: 1px solid var(--gsmui-input-border, var(--gsmui-color-border));
    border-radius: var(--gsmui-input-radius, var(--gsmui-radius-md));
}
```

### CSS Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `minify` | `true` | Minify output |
| `comments` | `false` | Include comments |
| `source_map` | `false` | Generate source map |
| `autoprefixer` | `true` | Add vendor prefixes |

## Minification

### Minification Process

| Step | Action |
|---|---|
| Remove comments | Strip all comments |
| Collapse whitespace | Minify spacing |
| Shorten colors | Use short forms |
| Merge rules | Combine selectors |
| Optimize values | Shorten values |

### Minification Results

| Metric | Before | After | Savings |
|---|---|---|---|
| File size | 45KB | 12KB | 73% |
| Gzipped | 45KB | 4KB | 91% |

### Minification Options

```javascript
// config/theme-engine.php
return [
    'css' => [
        'minify' => true,
        'minifier' => 'lightningcss', // 'lightningcss', 'cssnano'
        'options' => [
            'remove_comments' => true,
            'merge_rules' => true,
            'shorten_colors' => true,
        ],
    ],
];
```

## Source Maps

### Source Map Output

```css
/* Generated CSS */
.gsmui-button{background:var(--gsmui-button-bg,#2563eb)}

/*# sourceMappingURL=gsmui.min.css.map */
```

### Source Map Schema

```json
{
    "version": 3,
    "file": "gsmui.min.css",
    "sources": ["tokens.css", "components/button.css"],
    "names": [],
    "mappings": "AAAA..."
}
```

### Source Map Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source_map` | `false` | Enable source maps |
| `inline_sources` | `false` | Inline source content |
| `source_root` | `/` | Source root path |

## PostCSS Integration

### PostCSS Plugin

```javascript
// postcss.config.js
module.exports = {
    plugins: [
        require('@gsmui/theme-engine/postcss')({
            prefix: 'gsmui',
            minify: true,
        }),
    ],
};
```

### PostCSS Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Token replacement | Replace token references |
| Custom properties | Resolve variables |
| Autoprefixing | Add vendor prefixes |
| Minification | Optimize output |

## CSS API

### PHP API

```php
use Gsmui\Theme\CssGenerator;

// Generate CSS
$css = CssGenerator::generate($tokens);

// Generate with options
$css = CssGenerator::generate($tokens, [
    'minify' => true,
    'source_map' => false,
    'format' => 'expanded',
]);

// Generate Tailwind config
$config = CssGenerator::tailwindConfig($tokens);

// Save to file
CssGenerator::save($tokens, public_path('css/gsmui.css'));
```

### CLI API

```bash
# Generate CSS
gsmui-theme:css --output=public/css/gsmui.css

# Generate Tailwind config
gsmui-theme:tailwind --output=tailwind.config.js

# Generate with options
gsmui-theme:css --minify --source-map --output=public/css/gsmui.css
```

## Performance

| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| CSS generation | < 100ms |
| Minification | < 50ms |
| Source map gen | < 200ms |
| Output size (minified) | < 15KB |
| Output size (gzipped) | < 5KB |
